ordered_choices.concept: Inside a neighborhood bicycle workshop, a wheel mechanic turns one spoke nipple in a truing stand; the spinning rim nearly clears the stationary gauge where its preceding wobble left a small chalk mark.

Inside a pottery glaze studio, a maker pours a narrow glaze stream onto a shallow bowl supported on a turntable; the newly coated half has a glossy wet surface while the remaining clay rim stays matte.

Inside a small textile studio, a weaver passes a wooden shuttle through an open warp shed on a compact loom; the newly woven band repeats the previous stripe while an unfinished gap remains ahead of the shuttle.

Inside an instrument repair room, a bass player stops a string with the left hand and draws a short bow stroke with the right; a nearby electronic tuner shows the pitch settling while the instrument remains grounded on its endpin.
ordered_choices.action_structure: coordinated fingering and bowing creates a test response

ordered_choices.concept: Inside a tiny mechanical planetarium rehearsal room, an operator turns the projector focus wheel; a small star cluster sharpens on the curved wall beside a still-soft neighboring pattern.
Inside a tea blending shop, a blender tips a tiny scoop into one pan of a brass scale; the newly added leaves begin to level the beam beside a comparison jar and an unfinished blend.

Inside a miniature puppet theater rehearsal room, a performer moves a rod puppet across a fixed lamp beam; its sharply defined shadow begins to meet a painted doorway while a second empty doorway remains visible.
ordered_choices.action_structure: directed movement changes a projected relationship

ordered_choices.concept: Inside a clock repair room, a restorer lowers a small gear into an open movement resting on a table; its teeth begin to mesh with the stationary neighboring wheel while a spring remains visibly tensioned.
ordered_choices.action_structure: component assembly creates a meshing relation

purpose: Build a striped scarf with an even edge.
difficulty: The current weft needs slack so its next pass does not pull the cloth edge inward.

visible_result: A straight fresh rust stripe lies beside the remaining bare warp and a curved current pale yarn.
